# ryli.app
#
# Until this file existed, the only robots.txt served here was Cloudflare's
# auto-generated one, which is entirely comments -- no User-agent line, no
# Allow, and crucially no Sitemap pointer. Crawlers had nothing to act on.

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# The one line that actually helps: it tells every crawler where the full URL
# list lives, with a lastmod date per page, instead of leaving them to find
# pages by following links.
Sitemap: https://ryli.app/sitemap.xml

# Content signals, in Cloudflare's format, so switching to a real robots.txt
# does not silently drop the declaration their generated one carried.
# search = yes because search traffic is the point of this site. ai-input and
# ai-train are deliberately left unstated, which under this scheme neither
# grants nor restricts them -- the same position as before this file.
User-agent: *
Content-Signal: search=yes
